diagnosis: Account is on standard support tier, which retains audit logs for only 90 days. Customer needs 12 months, which requires a premium support tier upgrade.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Our audit log retention depends on your support tier. With a standard support tier, logs are retained for 90 days. To access 12 months of audit logs, you would need a premium support tier. You can explore upgrading your plan in your account settings. For more details, please refer to our article on audit log retention and export (kb-0013).
